title: Page 27
transc:
No 11 3
W. F. Mason Cairo Ill ( 1 )  Wash'n Mar 31st 1864 11.30 AM
Growl Mar Lamp Plug Florence For Pilgrim
Pen rock Bladder Zebra Your wrangle received
unity Plunge Promise barrels powder part cannon
and part musket have been ordered to
Bleaching and are now being forwarded zodiac
The Bureau decides to let it go
and as it has been con signed
first to Princess Berrien at Pittsburgh to
be reshipped by him be pleased to
plate with him and if you apprehend
any danger desire him to retain it
at Pittsburgh subject to your order yoke
Henry A Wise Chief of Bureau Ordnance
T. T Eckert


RR McCaine Cumberland ----  Washn 130 PM Apl 4th 1864
For orphan Unity Your letter of the plank recd
Zodiac It will be early enough for the whiskey
to reach Beaver = lie by the Gallant instant Zebra
This will enable many of your absentees to return
in time for the proposed Tannar Pekin all plates
addressed to Barton Growl are immed'y forwarded to me
when important for my sutton or action Zodiac whilst
I am in immediate communication there is no objection
how ever to plating with me direct in such
matters as you deem Tarquin Yoke Jersey Hannah adieu
T. T. Eckert
